variants.headline: Still in view: strike collapses
variants.sub: The union {name} has seen its strike collapse.
variants.body:
The strike by the union {name} has collapsed. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

Workers deserve solidarity in an unwelcome outcome as well as an attractive one. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Still in view: labour action loses its course
variants.sub: The strike by {name} has ended in collapse.
variants.body:
The union {name} has seen its strike collapse. This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event.

Workers deserve solidarity in an unwelcome outcome as well as an attractive one. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Still in view: a strike ends in collapse

variants.body:
